text:
Mira: quick check — onboarding 'hera-7b' v1 has schema-lint failing in CI. Error: missing required field 'serve.constraints.max_seq'. Weights: gs://redwood-models/hera-7b/v1/weights.pt. Tokenizer: sentencepiece spm.model (pad id looks like 0 in artifacts). Any quick fixes or compatibility suggestions? cc @caroline

ci-bot: schema-lint failed: missing field serve.constraints.max_seq (rule R-serve-01). Full log: /ci/logs/1732100000. Command used: ./tools/schema_lint config.json

Sam: Mira — quick workaround for the CI block: add a default serve.constraints entry in config.json. Example snippet to drop into PR:
```
{
  "serve": { "constraints": { "max_seq": 2048 } },
  "tokenizer": { "type": "sentencepiece", "model": "gs://redwood-models/hera-7b/v1/spm.model", "pad_id": 1 }
}
```
Note: only change pad_id if you confirm the tokenizer expects 1.

Devin: quick tokenization check you can run locally:
```
python -c "from sentencepiece import SentencePieceProcessor as SPP; p=SPP(); p.load('spm.model'); print('pad', p.pad_id(), 'bos', p.bos_id(), 'eos', p.eos_id())"
```
I ran it against the artifact: pad=0, bos=1, eos=2.

Caroline: if artifacts show pad=0 then we should NOT rewrite the tokenizer.pad_id to 1. Instead let's add a compatibility key to the serving config: "tokenizer_overrides": { "pad_remap": { "from": 0, "to": 1 } } so the runtime can remap token ids at load time. That avoids changing the model artifact. I'll prepare a small schema update to accept tokenizer_overrides (nullable) + migration note.

mira: thanks. created WIP PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/456 — WIP includes default serve.constraints only. @sam can you add the tokenizer_overrides proposal? @devin can you paste the small output you ran in the PR? :eyes:

Sam: on it, will add the serve.constraints default and a comment about why we don't mutate artifacts. :thumbsup:

Devin: pasted token ids output in PR comment and attached a tiny script that asserts pad==0. Recommend runtime remap approach.

eng-runtime: we can implement pad_remap in the runtime loader. Need a schema validator update to allow tokenizer_overrides. We prefer an explicit boolean flag "remap_token_ids" plus a small mapping object. Also adding this will require a migration note and a test in runtime-tests. No blocker from infra side.

Caroline: I'll add the schema change + unit test. Migration note: "If your tokenizer artifact uses nonstandard pad id, set tokenizer_overrides.pad_remap.from to the artifact value and to to the desired runtime id. This is applied at load time; no model weights modified."

Mira: perfect. I'll mark this thread as resolved in the PR once schema + runtime PRs land. Thanks all. :shipit:
